objective: Freeze a bounded V&V contract for a future connected mixed TET4/WEDGE6/HEX8 harmonic campaign without changing the production formulation or declaring a maturity promotion.

scope.backend: small-system SciPy complex reference path only for 02C; no distributed-runtime claim
scope.geometry: WP13-01K compact elbow at n=1: HEX8 box [0,1]x[-1,0]x[0,1], WEDGE6 right-triangular prism x>=0,y>=0,x+y<=1,z in [0,2], and a TET4 continuation over z in [2,3], with shared conforming interfaces and 48 translational DOF.
scope.boundary_conditions: All translational DOFs on the HEX8 y=-1 support surface are fixed; no independent support is allowed on TET4 or WEDGE6.
scope.harmonic_load: Unit generalized modal force proportional to the independent first mode mass vector, applied as a fixed complex amplitude with zero phase; no frequency-dependent load retuning.
scope.monitored_dofs: The first modal coordinate and a fixed free-interface/probe displacement selected before execution; the probe list is part of the evidence record.

frequency_contract.reference_frequency: f1=omega1/(2*pi) from the independent dense generalized-eigen oracle
required_points: off-resonance points below and above f1
resonance point f1 with declared 2% damping

independent_oracle.method: Separate dense generalized eigensolve of independently scattered K/M contributions, followed by the closed-form first-mode SDOF FRF H(omega)=1/(k1-omega^2*m1+i*omega*c1).
independent_oracle.independence_boundary: The reference implementation must not call HarmonicResponseSolver, the production router, or the production frequency loop. It may consume an independently scattered K/M snapshot and scipy.linalg.eigh.
independent_oracle.role: Validates amplitude, phase, resonance and off-resonance behavior for the declared assembled system; it is not an external correlation and does not by itself qualify the element formulation.

predeclared_gates.interface_displacement_continuity: shared translational DOFs are unique and have zero jump
predeclared_gates.replay_frequency_grid: identical declared frequencies and same convergence status
predeclared_gates.pure_control: Record pure-family controls where a physically comparable control exists; never relabel a mixed result based on a control.
predeclared_gates.numerical_determinism: two complete replays under the same process and solver settings; raw bitwise identity is diagnostic only

required_evidence: independent dense K/M oracle and first-mode frequency
amplitude and phase at every declared frequency
complex dynamic residual and interface force transfer
explicit record of any rejected route or unsupported backend
abort_criteria: WEDGE6 remains rejected by the public harmonic compatibility preflight and no separately approved 02C route is available
consistent mass or Rayleigh damping assembly is not symmetric/compatible across the three families
no independent analytical or reduced FRF oracle can be implemented without reusing the production harmonic solver
interface continuity or dynamic force transfer fails
the conditioning contract fails before solving
a tolerance or frequency point would need to be changed after observing a result
a solver/formulation redesign is required rather than a bounded route enablement

claim_policy.maximum: Only a bounded, connected mixed harmonic evidence statement for the declared compact-elbow case, damping and frequency ratios may be considered after a separate 02C campaign and Owner review.
claim_policy.not_allowed: No general mixed harmonic support, no distributed-performance claim, no production maturity claim and no claim for routes outside this contract.
